svg.aria-label: The toad sage's tip: seal the lesson. Give a mistake that comes back twice a lasting fix, at the highest level that works: the architecture, a type, a check whose error names the fix, a test, and a written rule last. Prove that each new check fails on the past mistake. That is how the dojo gets stronger.
